title: MahoragaMod
description: Adaptation like Mahoraga to fight any enemy.
body:
This mod adds an adaptation mechanic to Minecraft, inspired by Mahoraga. Now your character can gradually adapt to any type of incoming damage, becoming increasingly resilient to enemy attacks.

Key Features:

Dynamic Adaptation: The more damage of a certain type you take, the less damage it will inflict on you next time.

Versatility: The system works against physical attacks, magic, fire, and even potion effects.

Balance: Adaptation takes time, making boss battles more tactical and engaging.
